propositions: The rebar-debug skill must record the originating ticket (caused_by link) before closing a bug ticket to enable defect escape rate measurement.
The automatic blame fallback charges defects to the wrong ticket when the fix site differs from the cause site, particularly for unmet consumer obligations that predate the introducing change.
The skill must explicitly handle the case where a producer change creates a requirement but consumers are never updated, using date and symbol-search tests to detect and attribute this pattern.
The --caused-by flag must be provided on bug close even when a caused_by link already exists, because the close command unconditionally invokes the blame fallback if the flag is absent.

Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees using make worktree name=<branch> and ensure the worktree virtualenv is prepended to PATH for all commands to prevent pre-commit hook failures.

The attribution step must be required in Phase 1 Stage 3 exit gate before RCA writeback and must support four resolution types: regression, unmet obligation, omission by scope-of-work, and unattributable.
